```blitzbasic
ReadInt:Int32 stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to read from. |

**Returns:** The next 4 bytes of the stream as an integer.

## Description

_Not documented yet._
